# The Problems of Philosophy

*[Russell](../philosophers/russell.md) · 1912*

A short introductory book written in a few weeks, and still the most widely read of his non-technical works. Russell sets out the distinction between [knowledge by acquaintance](../glossary/knowledge-by-acquaintance.md) and knowledge by description, the problem of induction, truth as correspondence and [realism about universals](../glossary/realism-of-universals.md).
